name: SIDLNE
subtitle: All your sports apps in one
promotionalText: TeamSnap, SportsEngine, GameChanger, LeagueApps and more, all in one family calendar. Plus carpools, schedule-change alerts and Siri.
description:
All your kids’ sports apps in one place. SIDLNE pulls every team schedule from TeamSnap, SportsEngine, GameChanger, LeagueApps and more into one shared family calendar, so every practice, game and tournament for every kid is in one place and everyone in the family sees the same plan.

• ONE CALENDAR FOR EVERY KID: Week and month views, color-coded by athlete. Filter to one kid with a tap.
• TEAM SCHEDULES SYNC AUTOMATICALLY: Paste the calendar link from TeamSnap, SportsEngine, LeagueApps, GameChanger and more, and SIDLNE keeps it up to date.
• SCHEDULE-CHANGE ALERTS: Get a notification when a game moves, changes fields, is cancelled or is added, so nobody shows up at the wrong time.
• CARPOOLS WITH OTHER FAMILIES: Invite other parents with a link, pick a drop-off and pick-up driver for every game, auto-assign drives fairly, and import or export a Google Sheet.
• RIDES, SORTED: See which events still need a driver and claim a ride in one tap.
• ARE YOU GOING?: Mark each kid Going, Maybe or Not going for every event.
• GAME DAY MIX: One tap to your kids’ pump-up playlist on Spotify, Apple Music or SiriusXM for the drive.
• HEY SIRI: “What’s next on SIDLNE?”, “Who’s driving on SIDLNE?” and “Take me to the game with SIDLNE”.
• TAKE ME THERE: One tap opens Waze straight to the field.
• GAME REMINDERS: Get a heads-up an hour before every practice and game.
• FAMILY CHAT: Keep co-parents, grandparents and carpool partners in the loop.

Private by design. Only the people you invite can see your family’s schedule. There are no ads and no tracking, and you can delete your account at any time in the app.
reviewNotes:
PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
SIDLNE is a free, private family sports calendar for parents of kids who play youth sports. It pulls each team's schedule from the team's own app (TeamSnap, SportsEngine, GameChanger, LeagueApps and others) into one shared family calendar, and helps families coordinate who's driving. Users are adults (parents, grandparents, carpool partners). Only people a family invites can see its data. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads, or paid content.

SIGN IN
Use the demo account above. It belongs to a sample family (Review Family) with athletes, teams, upcoming events, a carpool and family chat. You can also create a new account with any email (Create an account).

MAIN FEATURES
• Overview: Up Next, Game Day mix (opens Spotify/Apple Music/SiriusXM).
• Calendar: week/month views of every kid's events.
• Teams: paste a team's public calendar (iCal) link to import its schedule.
• Rides: carpools with other families; assign drop-off and pick-up drivers.
• Any event: "Take me there" opens Waze; Going / Maybe / Not going.
• Chat: family chat.
• Family: invite members, reminders (local notifications), schedule-change alerts (push).
• Siri: "What's next on SIDLNE?" (App Shortcuts).

USER-GENERATED CONTENT (CHAT)
Chat is private to invited family members. Users agree to the Terms of Use (sidlne.app/terms.html, zero tolerance for objectionable content) when signing up. In Chat, tap "..." on any message to Report it (hidden right away; our team reviews reports within 24 hours and removes content and offending users) or Block the sender (their messages are hidden; unblock under Family > Blocked). Family admins can delete any message and remove members. Messages containing objectionable words are blocked before sending.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Family > Delete my account (bottom of the page).

EXTERNAL SERVICES
Supabase (sign-in, database), Cloudflare (website hosting), Apple Push Notification service, public team calendar links the user pastes in, Google Sheets (optional carpool import/export), and outbound links to Waze, Spotify, Apple Music and SiriusXM.

REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works the same in every region.

REGULATED / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not a regulated industry. SIDLNE shows only schedules the user's own teams publish, and does not use third-party copyrighted content.
privacyPolicyText: SIDLNE collects only what it needs to run your family calendar: your name and email to sign in, and the schedules, rides, carpools, playlists and messages you add, which only the people you invite can see. We don't sell your data, show ads or track you across apps. You can delete your account and data at any time in the app under Family → Delete my account. Full policy: https://sidlne.app/privacy.html
